This Pew Research Center report examines the energy demands of U.S. data centers in the context of rapid AI growth, emphasizing projected increases in electricity consumption, regional grid strains, and the sources of energy used. The analysis relies on data from the International Energy Agency (IEA) and highlights the potential impacts on household electricity bills and environmental concerns. Key topics include the types of data centers, their geographical distribution, and public attitudes toward AI's environmental effects.
